canonicalPrinciples.name: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Every critical entity property must have one authoritative source. No cache, legacy field, or UI state can override it.

canonicalPrinciples.name: QUALITY ≠ WORKFLOW DECOUPLING
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Quality status (PASS/FAIL/PENDING/UNKNOWN) is completely independent of workflow status (DRAFT/IN_REVIEW/FINAL/APPROVED/RELEASED).

canonicalPrinciples.name: NO IMPLICIT PASS
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Missing, null, empty, or error states must never default to PASS or isPass=true.

canonicalPrinciples.name: NO IMPLICIT FAIL
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Unfinished or unmapped data must remain PENDING or UNKNOWN, never forcibly converted to FAIL.

canonicalPrinciples.name: CANONICAL QUALITY EVALUATION
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Quality conclusions must only be evaluated by Canonical Quality Engine / Resolvers, not by UI components.

canonicalPrinciples.name: EVIDENCE BEFORE CONCLUSION
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Conclusions must be preceded by measurements, criteria results, and cryptographic snapshot sealing.

canonicalPrinciples.name: CURRENT DATA BEFORE LEGACY DATA
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Valid snapshot evaluation takes precedence over re-evaluation; re-evaluation takes precedence over legacy stored fields.

canonicalPrinciples.name: FINALIZED DATA PROTECTION
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Finalized, approved, or released records are strictly locked from direct modification.

canonicalPrinciples.name: AI IS ADVISORY
canonicalPrinciples.rule: AI operates strictly as Human-in-the-Loop advisory (OCR, prediction, proposal). AI cannot directly mutate regulated records.

canonicalPrinciples.name: FAIL CLOSED
canonicalPrinciples.rule: When required data or security conditions are missing, the system denies action immediately instead of guessing or scanning all data.

canonicalPrinciples.name: IMMUTABLE AUDIT
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Audit trails are append-only with SHA-256 hash chaining. Modification or deletion is blocked for all users including ADMIN.

canonicalPrinciples.name: TRACEABILITY
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Every decision must trace from Batch to TestResult, Criterion, Limits, TCCS, Formula, and Raw Material.

canonicalPrinciples.name: ATOMIC REGULATED MUTATION
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Multi-step mutations must be committed as atomic all-or-nothing transactions with rollback on failure.

canonicalPrinciples.name: VERSION AWARENESS
canonicalPrinciples.rule: Optimistic Concurrency Control rejects stale writes where expectedVersion !== currentVersion.

canonicalPrinciples.name: UI IS NOT BUSINESS AUTHORITY
canonicalPrinciples.rule: UI only presents state and invokes authorized services; UI does not determine domain truth.
